annotations.title: Check a clone for upstream updates

description: Has the build this flow was copied from released a newer version? Covers both a "Make it yours" clone of a listing and a build started from an FBB. Returns update.status: "available" (a newer deployed release exists — review it with get_upstream_update), "current" (up to date), "unknown" (the original has no comparable release), or "gone" (the original was DELETED — for a share clone, also if it was un-shared; an FBB's parent stays reachable while it exists, because the catalog vouches for it rather than the owner's share toggle), with the release notes published since the copy. Flows that are not snapshot-sourced copies return update: null. Cheap — safe to call whenever the user asks about updates.
name: flow_get_upstream_status
title: Check a clone for upstream updates
